file_stem: RWB E1 016 Access control per data product and catalog entries
title: Access control per data product and catalog entries
goal: Role-based read per data product: personal data masked, every read logged, each product findable in a catalog
why: PDPA: people see only the products their role needs, the ID number never leaves ACE in clear, and a read that cannot be logged is refused.

writes.note: who may read which product (versioned, approved)

reads.note: which role sees a field clear

stores: PII access log via the ACE common module to PII Kafka (INT-22). No tokenization anywhere.

functions.name: DataProductRecordService
functions.does: read views by key, mask fields

path.text: Access row in force + case scope?

rules: BR1: read only through a data_product_access row in force
BR3: with no masking rules loaded, every personal field is masked
BR4: a read that cannot be logged is refused
BR8/9: ID masked inside v_ace_customer; phone, email, address masked at the API
risks: No access row for the role -> 403 (MSG-P4-002)
PII log down -> 503, no data returned (MSG-GEN-006)
example: RW-AUDIT user u-audit-01 reads DP02 for case RW-2026-000102 (person_key P0000102)
One PII access log entry written: field names only, no values
